row.rowText: Community Disputes Registered At The Community Mediation Centre
row.footnote: Refer to the number of cases (voluntary and directed) registered at the Community Mediation Centre (CMC) for mediation.  The CMC provides voluntary mediation service for interpersonal disputes between neighbours, family members, friends, co-workers, landlords and tenants, and other types of interpersonal disputes that are not contractual or commercial.
